## The situation

You are a finalist for Head of Marketing. The founders want to see how you think and how you write before they see how you manage. Ground every factual claim about Ajaia's business, positioning, or content in what is real and public at ajaia.ai. Below, you will find two short exhibits: fragments of internal conversation and an internal note written for this exercise. These exhibits are fictional composites, not real Ajaia data, provided so you have something concrete to react to. Do not present anything from the exhibits as verified fact about Ajaia; ground your plan in what you can actually find at ajaia.ai.

## The exhibits (fictional composites, written for this exercise)

**Exhibit A. #leadership Slack thread**

> **Rana** (8:12 AM): ok I looked at the numbers again, paid CAC dropped 40% last week, I think we should just put more budget behind it this quarter and worry about content later
>
> **Theo** (8:20 AM): 40% over one week off a small spend base isn't a trend, that's noise. what's the CAC been the last 8 weeks
>
> **Rana** (8:22 AM): I'd have to pull that, I only looked at last week
>
> **Theo** (8:30 AM): also whoever we hire for this needs to actually own an answer to "why not just paid," founders are going to ask that in week one anyway

**Exhibit B. From Ajaia's brand voice note (internal, one page)**

> Plain and confident, not loud. No "unlock," no "seamless," no "game-changing," no "cutting-edge." If a sentence would work on any AI company's homepage, rewrite it until it only works on ours. We say what changed, not what might change.

## Tasks

**Task 1. AI think piece** (suggested 35 minutes)

Write the position piece a Head of Marketing publishes under their own name to make an enterprise buyer, someone who has already sat through a failed AI pilot, stop and read. 400 words minimum. No maximum. Take a position someone could disagree with. Do not write a summary of what AI is. Nothing you cannot support. No invented statistics. This is the centerpiece of this exercise; spend real time here.

**Task 2. AI commentary set** (suggested 25 minutes)

Write three short, platform-native takes on current AI developments of your choosing, written in Ajaia's voice (see Exhibit B). Each one is an actual take, not a summary of the news. Say what you actually think, not just what happened. Nothing you cannot support.

**Task 3. Make it** (suggested 20 minutes)

Pick one of your Task 2 takes and actually make it: a reel or a carousel, your choice, built only from public material at ajaia.ai. This is the real piece, not a plan for one. Submit it as a file or a link.

**Task 4. Content engine plan** (suggested 15 minutes)

Half a page. How would you build Ajaia's content engine over the next two quarters, grounded in what is real and public at ajaia.ai: the format bets you would make, how you would use a small team plus AI tooling, and the one number you would commit to, with the baseline you would need before you actually commit to it.

**Task 5. AI Workflow Note** (100 words max, suggested 10 minutes)

Name the AI tools you used and what for. Name the single most useful thing AI produced for you today and the single worst, and what you did about the worst.

**Video** (suggested 15 minutes, recorded inside the 120-minute window, screen and camera)

Present your Task 4 plan as if to Ajaia's founders, and assume a founder interrupts partway through to ask: "Why would we not just spend this on paid?" Answer it on camera. Then show the reel or carousel from Task 3 and say why you made the choices you made. Then read one of your Task 2 takes aloud as if you were about to publish it. Close with who you are, why this role and why Ajaia, and your salary expectations. Do not state your current or most recent compensation anywhere in this video or in your submission.

## Submission checklist

- Task 1 think piece, 400 words or more
- Task 2 three AI commentary takes
- Task 3 reel or carousel, submitted as a file or a link
- Task 4 content engine plan, half a page
- Task 5 AI Workflow Note
- Video, with the interruption answered, the reel or carousel shown, one take read aloud, and the close (who you are, why Ajaia, salary expectations)
- Optional: links to your own public work, if you have them
- A reference to ajaia.ai appears somewhere in the materials
- Every link opens for someone who is not you. Check this in a private browser window.
